description: This file defines the EmployeeTrackerController class within the OrangeHRM Performance module, responsible for handling employee tracking functionalities in the HRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component for employee tracking on pre-render.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerController
classes.description: Controller class for managing employee tracker view, extending from AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that initializes and sets the 'employee-trackers' Vue component.
